store.name: Second Helpings
store.tagline: Goods from the tables you keep returning to
store.about: Your roll is full of fresh pasta, a quick espresso standing up, and fruit from the market. These pieces bring that table home.

products.title: Pasta Board Tea Towel
products.prompt: Printed cotton tea towel, 18x28 in: a loose repeat of pasta shapes (ribbons, shells, twists) in tomato and basil on a linen ground, flat shapes at least 3 cm. Flat print, hemmed edges, no text.
products.why: Hand-made pasta is in 31% of your moments.

products.title: Counter Espresso Print
products.prompt: Wall art print, 11x14 in, matte paper: a single espresso cup and saucer seen from above as flat shapes in espresso brown and linen on a lemon ground, wide margins. No text.
products.why: Espresso at the counter shows up in 27% of your moments.

products.title: Market Fruit Pillow
products.prompt: Printed throw pillow, 18x18 in: a scattered pattern of lemons and halved figs in lemon, tomato and basil on linen, motifs at least 5 cm. Flat print, hidden zip, no text.
products.why: Market fruit stalls are in 18% of your moments.

products.title: Taco Night Plate
products.prompt: Decorative ceramic plate, 9 in, for display: a bold ring of folded taco shapes around the rim in tomato, lemon and basil on a linen ground. No text.
products.why: Street tacos are in 22% of your moments; a display plate until the maker confirms it is food-safe.
